## What and why

## How it was tested

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] A test fails without this change (or: why no test is possible)
- [ ] New statistics are checked against an independent result (exact integration, closed form or simulation), with a fixed `seed=` and a tolerance that matches the Monte Carlo error

## Docs

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## Unreleased` (if users would notice the change)
- [ ] README examples whose output changed were re-run and the real output pasted
